settings.title: Settings
settings.privacyBody: KarpaChess collects no personal data. It has no account, no ads, no analytics and no tracking, and it never connects to the internet. Your progress, settings, games and photos are stored only on your device, and in your device's own backups if you use them; they are never sent to us or to anyone else. In Settings you can erase your progress, settings and player photo, and deleting the app removes everything it stored. The full policy is at {url}
settings.sourceNotice: KarpaChess is free software under the GNU GPL v3. Its complete source code is at {url}
